note: Purser's register of ICT third-party service providers, after DORA Art. 28(3). Test money only: the Airwallex sandbox, Alta testnet and Visa via Airwallex Airi in the sandbox. No provider is under a negotiated contract: every account is a test or developer account on the provider's standard terms. Data levels are those of docs/security/data-classification.md; locations are those docs/privacy/data-inventory.md records, else 'not documented in this repository'. A test (test/compliance-third-parties.test.ts) holds every outside host the code calls to a provider here, and every host here to the code.

providers.name: Airwallex
providers.service: Business accounts, payouts and FX, virtual cards for the agents, webhooks, and Airi (agentic checkout)
functions: Issues and freezes each agent's virtual card
Sends webhooks Purser checks against its ledger

data_shared.what: Suppliers' names and bank details (beneficiaries), amounts, payouts, conversions, the agents' cardholders (placeholder personal details in the sandbox)
The hash of the terms the CFO signed, in a transfer's metadata (approval_sha256)

providers.location: Sandbox today (docs/privacy/data-inventory.md); the production region is not documented in this repository
providers.contract: none: a sandbox account on Airwallex's standard terms
providers.substitutes: Another licensed payment provider with an API for payouts and issued cards; the executors call it through src/airwallex/ (adapter, client)

providers.name: Visa, through Airwallex Airi
providers.service: Visa Intelligent Commerce: one agent purchase with one tokenised credential, through Airwallex's Airi
functions: One agent purchase at a merchant, after the cardholder's passkey in Airi

data_shared.what: The purchase (merchant, amount, description); Purser never sees a card number

providers.location: Through Airwallex's sandbox (no Visa host is called by Purser's code)
providers.substitutes: Agent purchases on the agent's own Airwallex card (src/policy/cards.ts), or none

providers.name: Alta (formerly Metal)
providers.service: Testnet chain, *USDZ, the x402 facilitator, and the contracts that hold agent mandates, clearing and receive policy
functions: Agent-to-agent payments (x402) within each agent's on-chain mandate
providers.configured_hosts: The chain's RPC endpoint is a credential, read from METAL_RPC_URL and never printed (src/metal/network.ts)

data_shared.what: Agents' addresses and amounts, written to a public testnet for good
The audit log's head hash (anchoring)

providers.substitutes: No chain: agent payments go by card or bank transfer only; the audit log is still hash-chained and signed without the anchor

providers.name: Anthropic (Claude API)
providers.service: Claude models: reading invoices and documents, the agents' reasoning, reviews, Ask Purser
functions: Reads invoices into typed data (checked by code)
The agents propose; they never approve or hold a key
Ask Purser answers from the docs, read-only

data_shared.what: Invoice text and documents to read, the agents' prompts, a person's question to Ask Purser

providers.contract: none: a developer API key on Anthropic's standard terms
providers.substitutes: Reading falls back to the plain parser (claude.fallback); the agents can be switched off and every payment proposed by a person; another model provider behind src/claude/

providers.name: Cloudflare
providers.service: Workers, D1, R2, Durable Objects, Queues, Email Routing, Workers Logs, Turnstile: the approval relay and Purser Cloud
functions: Serves the phone's approval pages and relays signed approvals to the runner
Hosts Purser Cloud and its data

data_shared.what: Everything Purser Cloud stores and every request it serves (the books, documents, people, security logs)
Sealed tokens and key hashes Purser Cloud keeps (never a secret in the clear)

providers.location: D1 placed in western Europe (--location weur); R2 bucket in the EU jurisdiction; Durable Objects and logs not pinned (docs/privacy/data-inventory.md)
providers.contract: none negotiated: the maintainer's account on Cloudflare's standard terms
providers.substitutes: Without the relay no passkey approval reaches the runner, so payments above the limits wait (they fail safe); Purser Cloud would move to another Workers-compatible host

providers.name: GitHub
providers.service: The source repository, pull requests, Actions CI, releases with Sigstore provenance, security alerts
functions: Change control (PC-21): every change through a pull request and CI

data_shared.what: The source code and its records (test money only); no company data

providers.contract: none: the maintainer's account on GitHub's standard terms
providers.substitutes: Any git host with CI; the repository is a full copy wherever it is cloned
